required_fixes: C1 behavioral detection control must exclude 304 responses or correctly handle 304 status codes in behavioral signal extraction. Current implementation treats 304 cache hits as behavioral changes (behavioral_delta=1.0) for valid tokens, causing false TN failures. Fix: either (a) exclude 304s from C1 calculation (consistent with primary metric), or (b) map 304 to effective_code=200 in behavioral signal extraction before computing behavioral_delta.

Raw evidence key structure mismatch: run_experiment_distributed.py writes keys with 'b_' prefix (b_local_per_condition, etc.) but raw_evidence/experiment_data.json has keys without prefix (local_per_condition, etc.). This suggests raw evidence may not have been generated by the claimed script version. Verify provenance chain.

Confound condition (C7) correlation incorrectly includes 304 responses (n=816 vs n=688 non-304). Spec mandates 304 exclusion for ALL correlations. Recompute C7 with 304 exclusion (still passes: |r|=-0.910 >= 0.15).
validity_findings: C1 MEASUREMENT VALIDITY THREAT: C1 behavioral detection TP/TN metric includes 304 responses. For valid tokens with cache enabled, 32-33/34 responses are 304 (cache hits). Behavioral signal assigns behavioral_delta=1.0 to 304s (due to status_code=304 mapping to default status_weight=0.5), causing TN=0.0588 for those conditions. This conflates cache hits with token validation failures. C1 fails (mean TN=0.686) but passes when 304s excluded (TN=1.0). Primary metric correctly excludes 304s.

Primary orthogonality metric (endpoint-stratified pooled Pearson r on non-304 samples) is VALID and correctly computed: B-DISTRIBUTED r=-0.0585, n=688, CI=[-0.1327, 0.0163], CI upper=0.0163 < 0.15, TOST p_upper=2.03e-8 < 0.05. All recomputations match producer's reported values exactly.

C5 cache heterogeneity check passes (|r_enabled - r_disabled|=0.0425 < 2*SE_pooled=0.1559). C6 B-LOCAL-ONLY baseline passes (|r|=0.0471 < 0.15). C7 confound passes (|r|=0.8855 with 304s included; |r|=0.910 with 304s excluded). C2 variance passes (3/3 endpoints with std>0).

Sample size: B-DISTRIBUTED n_non304=688 (target 816, MEASUREMENT_INVALID threshold 400). Adequate for delta=0.15 inference. Power analysis: min detectable |r| at n=688 is 0.075; observed |r|=0.0585 well within equivalence bounds.

Distributed testbed architecture verified: 2 independent Flask nodes (ports 18971,18972) with independent SQLite DBs, independent in-memory CDN caches, independent ETag generation, round-robin routing. Cache invalidation on node A does not propagate to node B. V1 UUID fix (uuid4 for all status codes) and V_ETAG permission leakage fix both applied.
baseline_findings: B-LOCAL-ONLY (C6): Stratified r=0.0471, n=684, |r|=0.0471 < 0.15. PASS. Matches parent experiment EXP-GRAPH-35530590140 (r=0.0410). No regression.
B-CONCURRENT: Stratified r=-0.0319, n=816. Concurrent load (N=5) does not introduce behavioral-structural coupling. PASS for equivalence.

B-CONFOUND-DISTRIBUTED (C7): With 304s included: r=-0.8855, n=816, |r|=0.8855 >= 0.15. With 304s excluded: r=-0.910, n=688, |r|=0.910 >= 0.15. Negative control PASS in both cases. V2 confound (fixed 'expired' request_id) robustly reproduces in distributed setting.

Parent experiment EXP-GRAPH-35530590140 reported C1 PASS (TN=1.0) but its raw evidence shows 304s with behavioral_delta=0.0. Current experiment's raw evidence shows 304s with behavioral_delta=1.0. Discrepancy suggests behavioral signal extraction changed between experiments (possibly session_status_code handling for 304s).
claim_ceiling: C-FRESHNESS orthogonality at delta=0.15 on distributed infrastructure is SUPPORTED by primary metric (stratified r=-0.0585, CI upper=0.0163 < 0.15, TOST p<0.05, n=688). However, frozen decision rule requires ALL C1-C7 PASS; C1 fails due to measurement validity issue (304 inclusion in behavioral detection control). Producer outcome=FALSIFIES is correct per frozen spec. Scientific ceiling: orthogonality holds on 2-node distributed Flask testbed with independent caches at delta=0.15; behavioral detection control needs 304-exclusion fix. Claim bounded to: Flask 3.1.3, PyJWT RS256, SQLite WAL-mode, 2-node independent in-memory CDN simulation, round-robin routing, n_non304=688.
